ヒマリィ.role: Human video creator and central character; struggling to attract viewers

ヒマリィ.note: Editorial phonetic spelling, not creator-verified Latin orthography. scene1.ks:8-12 and narration at 18 establish name and premise. The ev_baby key identifies Himarii speaking in scene9, not an infant speaker. Review other bubble keys per scene.

底辺Ytuberヒマリィ.note: 28 active occurrences. Preserve Ytuber, the source's fictionalized platform wording. Nameplate fits the shipped 360px plate at 26px in live Chromium.

巨大なキリギリス.role: Talking insect-like creature that enters Himarii's room; player-directed actions belong to this creature
巨大なキリギリス.register: Rough, colloquial, self-assured; stretched endings such as なァ and ねェ; may use 俺
巨大なキリギリス.note: scene2_undress.ks:52-64 identifies a creature resembling a katydid. Gender/sex not established by masculine speech. Use it where third-person reference is needed until stronger evidence. Japanese バッタ in Himarii's startled reaction is her approximate description, not a glossary correction. All sanran_ch dialogue was reviewed in scene context and belongs to the katydid; display aliases leave engine keys unchanged.
